synopsis: list file attributes on a Linux second extended file system
description: lsattr lists the file attributes on a second extended file system. See chattr(1) for a description of the attributes and what they mean.

options.desc: Recursively list attributes of directories and their contents.
List all files in directories, including files that start with `.'.
List directories like other files, rather than listing their contents.
Print the options using long names instead of single character abbreviations.

operands.name: files
operands.desc: lsattr lists the file attributes on a second extended file system.
